proposed_new.title: Stop normally on public episode termination during an articulated motion
proposed_new.trigger: Inside an existing motion helper, motion is the documented ExecutionResult and result is the mutable report mapping. The helper returns a continuation boolean; its caller must check False and return immediately, including within a pull loop. A terminated flag is an episode boundary, not proof of success. The excerpt replaces an exception on every non-ok motion.
proposed_new.code:
if motion.terminated or motion.truncated:
    result["phase"] = "environment_ended"
    result["environment_terminated"] = bool(motion.terminated)
    result["environment_truncated"] = bool(motion.truncated)
    return False
proposed_new.evidence: On seed51 v05 had task_success=True but program_ok=False because it raised on TERMINATED. v06 changed only public terminal control flow and passed both fields. v08 uses the same block and completed all development51-65 with15/15 program_ok and15/15 task_success; root owns task grading, policy never reads success.
